AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Field Management Practices? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Field Management Practices.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Field Management Practices.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Field Management Practices.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Field Management Practices.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Agricultural Land and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Land Preparation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Field Management Practices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. D — Producers

7. B — 100 °C

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.

11. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. C — Ice melting to water
